name: Signature Wordsmith Lite Family
tagline: The friendly one you'll actually open daily.
description: Signature Wordsmith Lite Family was designed around real daily chores, not demos. It speaks your printer, your scanner, and your cloud drive without plugins, accounts, or upsells. It ships ready for Phone + PC, installs in seconds, and every file it creates stays yours.
features: Word count, reading time, readability score
how_to: Open Signature Wordsmith Lite Family — the first-run tour points at the three things you'll use most.
Start a new file from the Blank gallery and make it yours.
Use the toolbar (or keyboard shortcuts) — everything autosaves as you go.
Share or export with one click: CSV and plain-text formats.
Find anything later with the built-in search — your work is always one word away.

versions.note: First Signature-line release — the complete core, stable and fast.

lineage: An original Signature-line full word processor by Justin Addam Higgins — inspired by the app class, copying no product, brand, or design.
purpose: The friendly one you'll actually open daily.
privacy: Your data stays on this device — downloads are built locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
